proof_body:
by
  intro G _ _ p n hp hS hc
  have hP : IsPGroup p G := IsPGroup.of_card hc
  have hZ := hP.bot_lt_center
  have hT : Subgroup.center G = ⊤ := (Subgroup.Normal.eq_bot_or_eq_top (inferInstance : (Subgroup.center G).Normal)).resolve_left hZ.ne'
  have hcomm : ∀ a b : G, a * b = b * a := fun a b => by
    have : a ∈ Subgroup.center G := by rw [hT]; trivial
    exact ((Subgroup.mem_center_iff.1 this) b).symm
  letI : CommGroup G := { (inferInstance : Group G) with mul_comm := hcomm }
  have hpr : (Nat.card G).Prime := IsSimpleGroup.prime_card
  rw [hc] at hpr
  rcases n with _ | _ | n
  · simp at hpr; exact absurd hpr Nat.not_prime_one
  · rfl
  · exact absurd hpr (Nat.Prime.not_prime_pow (by omega))
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] [Finite G] (p n : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], IsSimpleGroup G → Nat.card G = p ^ n → n = 1
